notes: The current IPA layer is broad/phonemic for most entries rather than a complete narrow phonetic transcription.
847 canonical entries currently lack an explicit primary-stress marker; these must not be advertised as fully stress-verified.
Open machine dictionaries are secondary cross-checks. Licensed LDC/QCRI data is registered as a gold reference but not bundled.
Qurʾān recitation is excluded from synthetic narration and remains real-recording-only.
